history.p: A numerical single-query scaled dot-product attention educational diagram: input token sequence exactly THREE blank token slots (cat/chases/dog later typeset); learnable separate projections produce THREE-row Q, THREE-row K of width one, and THREE-by-TWO V. Select SECOND row of Q, match against all three K to THREE score cells, normalize to THREE probability cells, then multiply each V row by its weight and aggregate by column into a TWO-cell output row. Need visible three weighted contribution rows of width TWO. All cells BLANK; no numbers. Can abstract nonselected Q values. dk=1 example, output values later added exactly. Rich clear operation flow. Labels will be added near matrices. Not copy reference composition.
